position is persisted before timeout and address response
GPS unavailable triggers fresh low-accuracy fallback
permission denial stops without repeated permission attempts
old cached position is rejected
coarse location is kept at deadline
retry keeps existing punch coordinates and only refreshes address
failed fresh acquisition never erases earlier coordinates
reacquired historical position is labeled as later location
reload retains early saved coordinates
all simultaneous per-record violations are collected
exact thresholds and one-second excess are distinguished
loading does not reset continuous driving in strict mode
continuous driving carries over split shifts with short gap
thirty-minute off-duty gap resets driving
rest violation appears on both adjoining shift dates
monthly excess and two-week excess are in general reasons
annual cumulative excess is reported only after crossing
unfinished following day cannot produce early two-day compliance
overlapping shifts are not double-counted in rolling 24h
